name: ERR_IO_PENDING
desc: An asynchronous IO operation is not yet complete. This usually does not indicate a fatal error. Typically this error will be generated as a notification to wait for some external notification that the IO operation finally completed.

name: ERR_FAILED
desc: A generic failure occurred.

name: ERR_ABORTED
desc: An operation was aborted (due to user action).

name: ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT
desc: An argument to the function is incorrect.

name: ERR_INVALID_HANDLE
desc: The handle or file descriptor is invalid.

name: ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND
desc: The file or directory cannot be found.

name: ERR_TIMED_OUT
desc: An operation timed out.

name: ERR_FILE_TOO_BIG
desc: The file is too large.

name: ERR_UNEXPECTED
desc: An unexpected error. This may be caused by a programming mistake or an invalid assumption.

name: ERR_ACCESS_DENIED
desc: Permission to access a resource, other than the network, was denied.

name: ERR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED
desc: The operation failed because of unimplemented functionality.

name: ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES
desc: There were not enough resources to complete the operation.

name: ERR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
desc: Memory allocation failed.

name: ERR_UPLOAD_FILE_CHANGED
desc: The file upload failed because the file's modification time was different from the expectation.

name: ERR_SOCKET_NOT_CONNECTED
desc: The socket is not connected.

name: ERR_FILE_EXISTS
desc: The file already exists.

name: ERR_FILE_PATH_TOO_LONG
desc: The path or file name is too long.

name: ERR_FILE_NO_SPACE
desc: Not enough room left on the disk.

name: ERR_FILE_VIRUS_INFECTED
desc: The file has a virus.

name: ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT
desc: The client chose to block the request.

name: ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED
desc: The network changed.

name: ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR
desc: The request was blocked by the URL block list configured by the domain administrator.

name: ERR_SOCKET_IS_CONNECTED
desc: The socket is already connected.

name: ERR_UPLOAD_STREAM_REWIND_NOT_SUPPORTED
desc: The upload failed because the upload stream needed to be re-read, due to a retry or a redirect, but the upload stream doesn't support that operation.

name: ERR_CONTEXT_SHUT_DOWN
desc: The request failed because the URLRequestContext is shutting down, or has been shut down.

name: ERR_BLOCKED_BY_RESPONSE
desc: The request failed because the response was delivered along with requirements which are not met ('X-Frame-Options' and 'Content-Security-Policy' ancestor checks and 'Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy' for instance).

name: ERR_CLEARTEXT_NOT_PERMITTED
desc: The request was blocked by system policy disallowing some or all cleartext requests. Used for NetworkSecurityPolicy on Android.

name: ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CSP
desc: The request was blocked by a Content Security Policy

name: ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB
desc: The request was blocked by CORB or ORB.

name: ERR_NETWORK_ACCESS_REVOKED
desc: The request was blocked because it originated from a frame that has disabled network access.

name: ERR_BLOCKED_BY_FINGERPRINTING_PROTECTION
desc: The request was blocked by fingerprinting protections.

name: ERR_BLOCKED_IN_INCOGNITO_BY_ADMINISTRATOR
desc: The request was blocked by the Incognito Mode URL block list configured by the domain administrator.

name: ERR_LOCAL_NETWORK_PERMISSION_MISSING
desc: The request was blocked because the local network permission is missing. Note that this is different from BLOCKED_BY_LOCAL_NETWORK_ACCESS_CHECKS which is specifically for a CORS error code.

name: ERR_STRICT_ECH_REQUIRED
desc: The request was blocked because ECH is strictly required, but: - The client could not obtain a valid ECH configuration. - The server rejected the ECH, and the client failed to establish a new ECH connection after retrying with retry_configs.

name: ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED
desc: A connection was closed (corresponding to a TCP FIN).

name: ERR_CONNECTION_RESET
desc: A connection was reset (corresponding to a TCP RST).

name: ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED
desc: A connection attempt was refused.

name: ERR_CONNECTION_ABORTED
desc: A connection timed out as a result of not receiving an ACK for data sent. This can include a FIN packet that did not get ACK'd.

name: ERR_CONNECTION_FAILED
desc: A connection attempt failed.

name: ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED
desc: The host name could not be resolved.

name: ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED
desc: The Internet connection has been lost.

name: ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR
desc: An SSL protocol error occurred.

name: ERR_ADDRESS_INVALID
desc: The IP address or port number is invalid (e.g., cannot connect to the IP address 0 or the port 0).

name: ERR_ADDRESS_UNREACHABLE
desc: The IP address is unreachable. This usually means that there is no route to the specified host or network.

name: ERR_SSL_CLIENT_AUTH_CERT_NEEDED
desc: The server requested a client certificate for SSL client authentication.

name: ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED
desc: A tunnel connection through the proxy could not be established. For more info see the comment on PROXY_UNABLE_TO_CONNECT_TO_DESTINATION.

name: ERR_SSL_VERSION_OR_CIPHER_MISMATCH
desc: The client and server don't support a common SSL protocol version or cipher suite.

name: ERR_SSL_RENEGOTIATION_REQUESTED
desc: The server requested a renegotiation (rehandshake).

name: ERR_PROXY_AUTH_UNSUPPORTED
desc: The proxy requested authentication (for tunnel establishment) with an unsupported method.

name: ERR_BAD_SSL_CLIENT_AUTH_CERT
desc: The SSL handshake failed because of a bad or missing client certificate.

name: ERR_CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT
desc: A connection attempt timed out.

name: ERR_HOST_RESOLVER_QUEUE_TOO_LARGE
desc: There are too many pending DNS resolves, so a request in the queue was aborted.

name: ERR_SOCKS_CONNECTION_FAILED
desc: Failed establishing a connection to the SOCKS proxy server for a target host.

name: ERR_SOCKS_CONNECTION_HOST_UNREACHABLE
desc: The SOCKS proxy server failed establishing connection to the target host because that host is unreachable.

name: ERR_ALPN_NEGOTIATION_FAILED
desc: The request to negotiate an alternate protocol failed.

name: ERR_SSL_NO_RENEGOTIATION
desc: The peer sent an SSL no_renegotiation alert message.

name: ERR_WINSOCK_UNEXPECTED_WRITTEN_BYTES
desc: Winsock sometimes reports more data written than passed. This is probably due to a broken LSP.

name: ERR_SSL_DECOMPRESSION_FAILURE_ALERT
desc: An SSL peer sent us a fatal decompression_failure alert. This typically occurs when a peer selects DEFLATE compression in the mistaken belief that it supports it.

name: ERR_SSL_BAD_RECORD_MAC_ALERT
desc: An SSL peer sent us a fatal bad_record_mac alert. This has been observed from servers with buggy DEFLATE support.

name: ERR_PROXY_AUTH_REQUESTED
desc: The proxy requested authentication (for tunnel establishment).

name: ERR_PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED
desc: Could not create a connection to the proxy server. An error occurred either in resolving its name, or in connecting a socket to it. Note that this does NOT include failures during the actual "CONNECT" method of an HTTP proxy.

name: ERR_MANDATORY_PROXY_CONFIGURATION_FAILED
desc: A mandatory proxy configuration could not be used. Currently this means that a mandatory PAC script could not be fetched, parsed or executed.

name: ERR_PRECONNECT_MAX_SOCKET_LIMIT
desc: We've hit the max socket limit for the socket pool while preconnecting. We don't bother trying to preconnect more sockets.

name: ERR_SSL_CLIENT_AUTH_PRIVATE_KEY_ACCESS_DENIED
desc: The permission to use the SSL client certificate's private key was denied.

name: ERR_SSL_CLIENT_AUTH_CERT_NO_PRIVATE_KEY
desc: The SSL client certificate has no private key.

name: ERR_PROXY_CERTIFICATE_INVALID
desc: The certificate presented by the HTTPS Proxy was invalid.

name: ERR_NAME_RESOLUTION_FAILED
desc: An error occurred when trying to do a name resolution (DNS).

name: ERR_NETWORK_ACCESS_DENIED
desc: Permission to access the network was denied. This is used to distinguish errors that were most likely caused by a firewall from other access denied errors. See also ERR_ACCESS_DENIED.

name: ERR_TEMPORARILY_THROTTLED
desc: The request throttler module cancelled this request to avoid DDOS.

name: ERR_SSL_CLIENT_AUTH_SIGNATURE_FAILED
desc: We were unable to sign the CertificateVerify data of an SSL client auth handshake with the client certificate's private key.

name: ERR_MSG_TOO_BIG
desc: The message was too large for the transport. (for example a UDP message which exceeds size threshold).

name: ERR_WS_PROTOCOL_ERROR
desc: Websocket protocol error. Indicates that we are terminating the connection due to a malformed frame or other protocol violation.

name: ERR_ADDRESS_IN_USE
desc: Returned when attempting to bind an address that is already in use.

name: ERR_SSL_PINNED_KEY_NOT_IN_CERT_CHAIN
desc: The certificate didn't match the built-in public key pins for the host name. The pins are set in net/http/transport_security_state.cc and require that one of a set of public keys exist on the path from the leaf to the root.

name: ERR_CLIENT_AUTH_CERT_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED
desc: Server request for client certificate did not contain any types we support.

name: ERR_SSL_DECRYPT_ERROR_ALERT
desc: An SSL peer sent us a fatal decrypt_error alert. This typically occurs when a peer could not correctly verify a signature (in CertificateVerify or ServerKeyExchange) or validate a Finished message.

name: ERR_WS_THROTTLE_QUEUE_TOO_LARGE
desc: There are too many pending WebSocketJob instances, so the new job was not pushed to the queue.

name: ERR_SSL_SERVER_CERT_CHANGED
desc: The SSL server certificate changed in a renegotiation.

name: ERR_SSL_UNRECOGNIZED_NAME_ALERT
desc: The SSL server sent us a fatal unrecognized_name alert.

name: ERR_SOCKET_SET_RECEIVE_BUFFER_SIZE_ERROR
desc: Failed to set the socket's receive buffer size as requested.

name: ERR_SOCKET_SET_SEND_BUFFER_SIZE_ERROR
desc: Failed to set the socket's send buffer size as requested.

name: ERR_SOCKET_RECEIVE_BUFFER_SIZE_UNCHANGEABLE
desc: Failed to set the socket's receive buffer size as requested, despite success return code from setsockopt.

name: ERR_SOCKET_SEND_BUFFER_SIZE_UNCHANGEABLE
desc: Failed to set the socket's send buffer size as requested, despite success return code from setsockopt.

name: ERR_SSL_CLIENT_AUTH_CERT_BAD_FORMAT
desc: Failed to import a client certificate from the platform store into the SSL library.

name: ERR_ICANN_NAME_COLLISION
desc: Resolving a hostname to an IP address list included the IPv4 address "127.0.53.53". This is a special IP address which ICANN has recommended to indicate there was a name collision, and alert admins to a potential problem.

name: ERR_SSL_SERVER_CERT_BAD_FORMAT
desc: The SSL server presented a certificate which could not be decoded. This is not a certificate error code as no X509Certificate object is available. This error is fatal.

name: ERR_CT_STH_PARSING_FAILED
desc: Certificate Transparency: Received a signed tree head that failed to parse.

name: ERR_CT_STH_INCOMPLETE
desc: Certificate Transparency: Received a signed tree head whose JSON parsing was OK but was missing some of the fields.

name: ERR_UNABLE_TO_REUSE_CONNECTION_FOR_PROXY_AUTH
desc: The attempt to reuse a connection to send proxy auth credentials failed before the AuthController was used to generate credentials. The caller should reuse the controller with a new connection. This error is only used internally by the network stack.

name: ERR_CT_CONSISTENCY_PROOF_PARSING_FAILED
desc: Certificate Transparency: Failed to parse the received consistency proof.

name: ERR_SSL_OBSOLETE_CIPHER
desc: The SSL server required an unsupported cipher suite that has since been removed. This error will temporarily be signaled on a fallback for one or two releases immediately following a cipher suite's removal, after which the fallback will be removed.

name: ERR_WS_UPGRADE
desc: When a WebSocket handshake is done successfully and the connection has been upgraded, the URLRequest is cancelled with this error code.

name: ERR_READ_IF_READY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED
desc: Socket ReadIfReady support is not implemented. This error should not be user visible, because the normal Read() method is used as a fallback.

name: ERR_NO_BUFFER_SPACE
desc: No socket buffer space is available.

name: ERR_SSL_CLIENT_AUTH_NO_COMMON_ALGORITHMS
desc: There were no common signature algorithms between our client certificate private key and the server's preferences.

name: ERR_EARLY_DATA_REJECTED
desc: TLS 1.3 early data was rejected by the server. This will be received before any data is returned from the socket. The request should be retried with early data disabled.

name: ERR_WRONG_VERSION_ON_EARLY_DATA
desc: TLS 1.3 early data was offered, but the server responded with TLS 1.2 or earlier. This is an internal error code to account for a backwards-compatibility issue with early data and TLS 1.2. It will be received before any data is returned from the socket. The request should be retried with early data disabled.

name: ERR_TLS13_DOWNGRADE_DETECTED
desc: TLS 1.3 was enabled, but a lower version was negotiated and the server returned a value indicating it supported TLS 1.3. This is part of a security check in TLS 1.3, but it may also indicate the user is behind a buggy TLS-terminating proxy which implemented TLS 1.2 incorrectly. (See https://crbug.com/boringssl/226.)

name: ERR_SSL_KEY_USAGE_INCOMPATIBLE
desc: The server's certificate has a keyUsage extension incompatible with the negotiated TLS key exchange method.

name: ERR_INVALID_ECH_CONFIG_LIST
desc: The ECHConfigList fetched over DNS cannot be parsed.

name: ERR_ECH_NOT_NEGOTIATED
desc: ECH was enabled, but the server was unable to decrypt the encrypted ClientHello.

name: ERR_ECH_FALLBACK_CERTIFICATE_INVALID
desc: ECH was enabled, the server was unable to decrypt the encrypted ClientHello, and additionally did not present a certificate valid for the public name.

name: ERR_PROXY_UNABLE_TO_CONNECT_TO_DESTINATION
desc: An attempt to proxy a request failed because the proxy wasn't able to successfully connect to the destination. This likely indicates an issue with the request itself (for instance, the hostname failed to resolve to an IP address or the destination server refused the connection). This error code is used to indicate that the error is outside the control of the proxy server and thus the proxy chain should not be marked as bad. This is in contrast to ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED which is used for general purpose errors connecting to the proxy and by the proxy request response handling when a proxy delegate doesn't indicate via a different error code whether the failure was specific to the destination. By default, neither error code causes the proxy chain to be marked as bad, though a ProxyDelegate may override fallback behavior via CanFalloverToNextProxyOverride().

name: ERR_PROXY_DELEGATE_CANCELED_CONNECT_REQUEST
desc: Some implementations of ProxyDelegate query a separate entity to know whether it should cancel tunnel prior to: - The HTTP CONNECT requests being sent out - The HTTP CONNECT response being parsed by //net An example is CronetProxyDelegate: Cronet allows developers to decide whether the tunnel being established should be canceled.

name: ERR_CONTROL_MSG_TOO_BIG
desc: The control message was too large for the transport. (for example a UDP message control data exceeds size threshold).

name: ERR_MULTICAST_NOT_ALLOWED
desc: Direct Sockets attempted to connect to or send a packet to a multicast address without 'direct-sockets-multicast' permissions policy.

name: ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID
desc: The server responded with a certificate whose common name did not match the host name. This could mean:

name: ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID
desc: The server responded with a certificate that, by our clock, appears to either not yet be valid or to have expired. This could mean:

name: ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID
desc: The server responded with a certificate that is signed by an authority we don't trust. The could mean:

name: ERR_CERT_CONTAINS_ERRORS
desc: The server responded with a certificate that contains errors. This error is not recoverable.

name: ERR_CERT_NO_REVOCATION_MECHANISM
desc: The certificate has no mechanism for determining if it is revoked. In effect, this certificate cannot be revoked.

name: ERR_CERT_UNABLE_TO_CHECK_REVOCATION
desc: Revocation information for the security certificate for this site is not available. This could mean:

name: ERR_CERT_REVOKED
desc: The server responded with a certificate has been revoked. We have the capability to ignore this error, but it is probably not the thing to do.

name: ERR_CERT_INVALID
desc: The server responded with a certificate that is invalid. This error is not recoverable.

name: ERR_CERT_WEAK_SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM
desc: The server responded with a certificate that is signed using a weak signature algorithm.

name: ERR_CERT_NON_UNIQUE_NAME
desc: The host name specified in the certificate is not unique.

name: ERR_CERT_WEAK_KEY
desc: The server responded with a certificate that contains a weak key (e.g. a too-small RSA key).

name: ERR_CERT_NAME_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION
desc: The certificate claimed DNS names that are in violation of name constraints.

name: ERR_CERT_VALIDITY_TOO_LONG
desc: The certificate's validity period is too long.

name: ERR_CERTIFICATE_TRANSPARENCY_REQUIRED
desc: Certificate Transparency was required for this connection, but the server did not provide CT information that complied with the policy.

name: ERR_CERT_KNOWN_INTERCEPTION_BLOCKED
desc: The certificate is known to be used for interception by an entity other the device owner.

name: ERR_CERT_SELF_SIGNED_LOCAL_NETWORK
desc: The certificate is self signed and it's being used for either an RFC1918 IP literal URL, or a url ending in .local.

name: ERR_CERT_END
desc: The value immediately past the last certificate error code.

name: ERR_INVALID_URL
desc: The URL is invalid.

name: ERR_DISALLOWED_URL_SCHEME
desc: The scheme of the URL is disallowed.

name: ERR_UNKNOWN_URL_SCHEME
desc: The scheme of the URL is unknown.

name: ERR_INVALID_REDIRECT
desc: Attempting to load an URL resulted in a redirect to an invalid URL.

name: ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS
desc: Attempting to load an URL resulted in too many redirects.

name: ERR_UNSAFE_REDIRECT
desc: Attempting to load an URL resulted in an unsafe redirect (e.g., a redirect to file:// is considered unsafe).

name: ERR_UNSAFE_PORT
desc: Attempting to load an URL with an unsafe port number. These are port numbers that correspond to services, which are not robust to spurious input that may be constructed as a result of an allowed web construct (e.g., HTTP looks a lot like SMTP, so form submission to port 25 is denied).

name: ERR_INVALID_RESPONSE
desc: The server's response was invalid.

name: ERR_INVALID_CHUNKED_ENCODING
desc: Error in chunked transfer encoding.

name: ERR_METHOD_NOT_SUPPORTED
desc: The server did not support the request method.

name: ERR_UNEXPECTED_PROXY_AUTH
desc: The response was 407 (Proxy Authentication Required), yet we did not send the request to a proxy.

name: ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE
desc: The server closed the connection without sending any data.

name: ERR_RESPONSE_HEADERS_TOO_BIG
desc: The headers section of the response is too large.

name: ERR_PAC_SCRIPT_FAILED
desc: The evaluation of the PAC script failed.

name: ERR_REQUEST_RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE
desc: The response was 416 (Requested range not satisfiable) and the server cannot satisfy the range requested.

name: ERR_MALFORMED_IDENTITY
desc: The identity used for authentication is invalid.

name: ERR_CONTENT_DECODING_FAILED
desc: Content decoding of the response body failed.

name: ERR_NETWORK_IO_SUSPENDED
desc: An operation could not be completed because all network IO is suspended.

name: ERR_NO_SUPPORTED_PROXIES
desc: There are no supported proxies in the provided list.

name: ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR
desc: There is an HTTP/2 protocol error.

name: ERR_INVALID_AUTH_CREDENTIALS
desc: Credentials could not be established during HTTP Authentication.

name: ERR_UNSUPPORTED_AUTH_SCHEME
desc: An HTTP Authentication scheme was tried which is not supported on this machine.

name: ERR_ENCODING_DETECTION_FAILED
desc: Detecting the encoding of the response failed.

name: ERR_MISSING_AUTH_CREDENTIALS
desc: (GSSAPI) No Kerberos credentials were available during HTTP Authentication.

name: ERR_UNEXPECTED_SECURITY_LIBRARY_STATUS
desc: An unexpected, but documented, SSPI or GSSAPI status code was returned.

name: ERR_MISCONFIGURED_AUTH_ENVIRONMENT
desc: The environment was not set up correctly for authentication (for example, no KDC could be found or the principal is unknown.

name: ERR_UNDOCUMENTED_SECURITY_LIBRARY_STATUS
desc: An undocumented SSPI or GSSAPI status code was returned.

name: ERR_RESPONSE_BODY_TOO_BIG_TO_DRAIN
desc: The HTTP response was too big to drain.

name: ERR_RESPONSE_HEADERS_MULTIPLE_CONTENT_LENGTH
desc: The HTTP response contained multiple distinct Content-Length headers.

name: ERR_INCOMPLETE_HTTP2_HEADERS
desc: HTTP/2 headers have been received, but not all of them - status or version headers are missing, so we're expecting additional frames to complete them.

name: ERR_PAC_NOT_IN_DHCP
desc: No PAC URL configuration could be retrieved from DHCP. This can indicate either a failure to retrieve the DHCP configuration, or that there was no PAC URL configured in DHCP.

name: ERR_RESPONSE_HEADERS_MULTIPLE_CONTENT_DISPOSITION
desc: The HTTP response contained multiple Content-Disposition headers.

name: ERR_RESPONSE_HEADERS_MULTIPLE_LOCATION
desc: The HTTP response contained multiple Location headers.

name: ERR_HTTP2_SERVER_REFUSED_STREAM
desc: HTTP/2 server refused the request without processing, and sent either a GOAWAY frame with error code NO_ERROR and Last-Stream-ID lower than the stream id corresponding to the request indicating that this request has not been processed yet, or a RST_STREAM frame with error code REFUSED_STREAM. Client MAY retry (on a different connection). See RFC7540 Section 8.1.4.

name: ERR_HTTP2_PING_FAILED
desc: HTTP/2 server didn't respond to the PING message.

name: ERR_CONTENT_LENGTH_MISMATCH
desc: The HTTP response body transferred fewer bytes than were advertised by the Content-Length header when the connection is closed.

name: ERR_INCOMPLETE_CHUNKED_ENCODING
desc: The HTTP response body is transferred with Chunked-Encoding, but the terminating zero-length chunk was never sent when the connection is closed.

name: ERR_QUIC_PROTOCOL_ERROR
desc: There is a QUIC protocol error.

name: ERR_RESPONSE_HEADERS_TRUNCATED
desc: The HTTP headers were truncated by an EOF.

name: ERR_QUIC_HANDSHAKE_FAILED
desc: The QUIC crypto handshake failed. This means that the server was unable to read any requests sent, so they may be resent.

name: ERR_HTTP2_INADEQUATE_TRANSPORT_SECURITY
desc: Transport security is inadequate for the HTTP/2 version.

name: ERR_HTTP2_FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR
desc: The peer violated HTTP/2 flow control.

name: ERR_HTTP2_FRAME_SIZE_ERROR
desc: The peer sent an improperly sized HTTP/2 frame.

name: ERR_HTTP2_COMPRESSION_ERROR
desc: Decoding or encoding of compressed HTTP/2 headers failed.

name: ERR_PROXY_AUTH_REQUESTED_WITH_NO_CONNECTION
desc: Proxy Auth Requested without a valid Client Socket Handle.

name: ERR_HTTP_1_1_REQUIRED
desc: HTTP_1_1_REQUIRED error code received on HTTP/2 session.

name: ERR_PROXY_HTTP_1_1_REQUIRED
desc: HTTP_1_1_REQUIRED error code received on HTTP/2 session to proxy.

name: ERR_PAC_SCRIPT_TERMINATED
desc: The PAC script terminated fatally and must be reloaded.

name: ERR_INVALID_HTTP_RESPONSE
desc: The server was expected to return an HTTP/1.x response, but did not. Rather than treat it as HTTP/0.9, this error is returned.

name: ERR_CONTENT_DECODING_INIT_FAILED
desc: Initializing content decoding failed.

name: ERR_HTTP2_RST_STREAM_NO_ERROR_RECEIVED
desc: Received HTTP/2 RST_STREAM frame with NO_ERROR error code. This error should be handled internally by HTTP/2 code, and should not make it above the SpdyStream layer.

name: ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES
desc: An HTTP transaction was retried too many times due for authentication or invalid certificates. This may be due to a bug in the net stack that would otherwise infinite loop, or if the server or proxy continually requests fresh credentials or presents a fresh invalid certificate.

name: ERR_HTTP2_STREAM_CLOSED
desc: Received an HTTP/2 frame on a closed stream.

name: ERR_HTTP_RESPONSE_CODE_FAILURE
desc: The server returned a non-2xx HTTP response code.

name: ERR_QUIC_CERT_ROOT_NOT_KNOWN
desc: The certificate presented on a QUIC connection does not chain to a known root and the origin connected to is not on a list of domains where unknown roots are allowed.

name: ERR_QUIC_GOAWAY_REQUEST_CAN_BE_RETRIED
desc: A GOAWAY frame has been received indicating that the request has not been processed and is therefore safe to retry on a different connection.

name: ERR_TOO_MANY_ACCEPT_CH_RESTARTS
desc: The ACCEPT_CH restart has been triggered too many times

name: ERR_INCONSISTENT_IP_ADDRESS_SPACE
desc: The IP address space of the remote endpoint differed from the previous observed value during the same request. Any cache entry for the affected request should be invalidated.

name: ERR_CACHED_IP_ADDRESS_SPACE_BLOCKED_BY_LOCAL_NETWORK_ACCESS_POLICY
desc: The IP address space of the cached remote endpoint is blocked by private network access check.

name: ERR_BLOCKED_BY_LOCAL_NETWORK_ACCESS_CHECKS
desc: The connection is blocked by private network access checks.

name: ERR_ZSTD_WINDOW_SIZE_TOO_BIG
desc: Content decoding failed due to the zstd window size being too big (over 8MB).

name: ERR_DICTIONARY_LOAD_FAILED
desc: The compression dictionary cannot be loaded.

name: ERR_UNEXPECTED_CONTENT_DICTIONARY_HEADER
desc: The header of dictionary compressed stream does not match the expected value.

name: ERR_CACHE_MISS
desc: The cache does not have the requested entry.

name: ERR_CACHE_READ_FAILURE
desc: Unable to read from the disk cache.

name: ERR_CACHE_WRITE_FAILURE
desc: Unable to write to the disk cache.

name: ERR_CACHE_OPERATION_NOT_SUPPORTED
desc: The operation is not supported for this entry.

name: ERR_CACHE_OPEN_FAILURE
desc: The disk cache is unable to open this entry.

name: ERR_CACHE_CREATE_FAILURE
desc: The disk cache is unable to create this entry.

name: ERR_CACHE_RACE
desc: Multiple transactions are racing to create disk cache entries. This is an internal error returned from the HttpCache to the HttpCacheTransaction that tells the transaction to restart the entry-creation logic because the state of the cache has changed.

name: ERR_CACHE_CHECKSUM_READ_FAILURE
desc: The cache was unable to read a checksum record on an entry. This can be returned from attempts to read from the cache. It is an internal error, returned by the SimpleCache backend, but not by any URLRequest methods or members.

name: ERR_CACHE_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH
desc: The cache found an entry with an invalid checksum. This can be returned from attempts to read from the cache. It is an internal error, returned by the SimpleCache backend, but not by any URLRequest methods or members.

name: ERR_CACHE_LOCK_TIMEOUT
desc: Internal error code for the HTTP cache. The cache lock timeout has fired.

name: ERR_CACHE_AUTH_FAILURE_AFTER_READ
desc: Received a challenge after the transaction has read some data, and the credentials aren't available. There isn't a way to get them at that point.

name: ERR_CACHE_ENTRY_NOT_SUITABLE
desc: Internal not-quite error code for the HTTP cache. In-memory hints suggest that the cache entry would not have been usable with the transaction's current configuration (e.g. load flags, mode, etc.)

name: ERR_CACHE_DOOM_FAILURE
desc: The disk cache is unable to doom this entry.

name: ERR_CACHE_OPEN_OR_CREATE_FAILURE
desc: The disk cache is unable to open or create this entry.

name: ERR_CACHE_COMPRESSION_FAILURE
desc: Zstd compression of a cache entry body failed.

name: ERR_INSECURE_RESPONSE
desc: The server's response was insecure (e.g. there was a cert error).

name: ERR_NO_PRIVATE_KEY_FOR_CERT
desc: An attempt to import a client certificate failed, as the user's key database lacked a corresponding private key.

name: ERR_ADD_USER_CERT_FAILED
desc: An error adding a certificate to the OS certificate database.

name: ERR_INVALID_SIGNED_EXCHANGE
desc: An error occurred while handling a signed exchange.

name: ERR_INVALID_WEB_BUNDLE
desc: An error occurred while handling a Web Bundle source.

name: ERR_TRUST_TOKEN_OPERATION_FAILED
desc: A Trust Tokens protocol operation-executing request failed for one of a number of reasons (precondition failure, internal error, bad response).

name: ERR_TRUST_TOKEN_OPERATION_SUCCESS_WITHOUT_SENDING_REQUEST
desc: When handling a Trust Tokens protocol operation-executing request, the system was able to execute the request's Trust Tokens operation without sending the request to its destination: for instance, the results could have been present in a local cache (for redemption) or the operation could have been diverted to a local provider (for "platform-provided" issuance).

name: ERR_HTTPENGINE_PROVIDER_IN_USE
desc: This is a placeholder value that should never be used within //net.

name: ERR_PKCS12_IMPORT_BAD_PASSWORD
desc: PKCS #12 import failed due to incorrect password.

name: ERR_PKCS12_IMPORT_FAILED
desc: PKCS #12 import failed due to other error.

name: ERR_IMPORT_CA_CERT_NOT_CA
desc: CA import failed - not a CA cert.

name: ERR_IMPORT_CERT_ALREADY_EXISTS
desc: Import failed - certificate already exists in database. Note it's a little weird this is an error but reimporting a PKCS12 is ok (no-op). That's how Mozilla does it, though.

name: ERR_IMPORT_CA_CERT_FAILED
desc: CA import failed due to some other error.

name: ERR_IMPORT_SERVER_CERT_FAILED
desc: Server certificate import failed due to some internal error.

name: ERR_PKCS12_IMPORT_INVALID_MAC
desc: PKCS #12 import failed due to invalid MAC.

name: ERR_PKCS12_IMPORT_INVALID_FILE
desc: PKCS #12 import failed due to invalid/corrupt file.

name: ERR_PKCS12_IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED
desc: PKCS #12 import failed due to unsupported features.

name: ERR_KEY_GENERATION_FAILED
desc: Key generation failed.

name: ERR_PRIVATE_KEY_EXPORT_FAILED
desc: Failure to export private key.

name: ERR_SELF_SIGNED_CERT_GENERATION_FAILED
desc: Self-signed certificate generation failed.

name: ERR_CERT_DATABASE_CHANGED
desc: The certificate database changed in some way.

name: ERR_CERT_VERIFIER_CHANGED
desc: The certificate verifier configuration changed in some way.

name: ERR_DNS_MALFORMED_RESPONSE
desc: DNS resolver received a malformed response.

name: ERR_DNS_SERVER_REQUIRES_TCP
desc: DNS server requires TCP

name: ERR_DNS_TIMED_OUT
desc: DNS transaction timed out.

name: ERR_DNS_CACHE_MISS
desc: The entry was not found in cache or other local sources, for lookups where only local sources were queried. TODO(ericorth): Consider renaming to DNS_LOCAL_MISS or something like that as the cache is not necessarily queried either.

name: ERR_DNS_SEARCH_EMPTY
desc: Suffix search list rules prevent resolution of the given host name.

name: ERR_DNS_SORT_ERROR
desc: Failed to sort addresses according to RFC3484.

name: ERR_DNS_SECURE_RESOLVER_HOSTNAME_RESOLUTION_FAILED
desc: Failed to resolve the hostname of a DNS-over-HTTPS server.

name: ERR_DNS_NAME_HTTPS_ONLY
desc: DNS identified the request as disallowed for insecure connection (http/ws). Error should be handled as if an HTTP redirect was received to redirect to https or wss.

name: ERR_DNS_REQUEST_CANCELLED
desc: All DNS requests associated with this job have been cancelled.

name: ERR_DNS_NO_MATCHING_SUPPORTED_ALPN
desc: The hostname resolution of HTTPS record was expected to be resolved with alpn values of supported protocols, but did not.

name: ERR_DNS_SECURE_PROBE_RECORD_INVALID
desc: When checking whether secure DNS can be used, the response returned for the requested probe record either had no answer or was invalid.

name: ERR_DNS_CACHE_INVALIDATION_IN_PROGRESS
desc: Returned when DNS cache invalidation is in progress. This is a transient error. Callers may want to retry later.

name: ERR_DNS_FORMAT_ERROR
desc: The DNS server responded with a format error response code.

name: ERR_DNS_SERVER_FAILURE
desc: The DNS server responded with a server failure response code.

name: ERR_DNS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED
desc: The DNS server responded that the query type is not implemented.

name: ERR_DNS_REFUSED
desc: The DNS server responded that the request was refused.

name: ERR_DNS_OTHER_FAILURE
desc: The DNS server responded with an rcode indicating that the request failed, but the rcode is not one that we have a specific error code for. In other words, the rcode was not one of the following: - NOERR - FORMERR - SERVFAIL - NXDOMAIN - NOTIMP - REFUSED

name: ERR_DNS_DIRECT_ONLY
desc: Declined to call DNS for a direct_only request of a hostname whose traffic would be routed through a proxy.

name: ERR_BLOB_INVALID_CONSTRUCTION_ARGUMENTS
desc: The construction arguments are invalid. This is considered a bad IPC.

name: ERR_BLOB_OUT_OF_MEMORY
desc: We don't have enough memory for the blob.

name: ERR_BLOB_FILE_WRITE_FAILED
desc: We couldn't create or write to a file. File system error, like a full disk.

name: ERR_BLOB_SOURCE_DIED_IN_TRANSIT
desc: The renderer was destroyed while data was in transit.

name: ERR_BLOB_DEREFERENCED_WHILE_BUILDING
desc: The renderer destructed the blob before it was done transferring, and there were no outstanding references (no one is waiting to read) to keep the blob alive.

name: ERR_BLOB_REFERENCED_BLOB_BROKEN
desc: A blob that we referenced during construction is broken, or a browser-side builder tries to build a blob with a blob reference that isn't finished constructing.

name: ERR_BLOB_REFERENCED_FILE_UNAVAILABLE
desc: A file that we referenced during construction is not accessible to the renderer trying to create the blob.
